## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The three-juan general table of contents to the 36-juan *Xù chuándēng lù* 續傳燈錄 ([KR6q0016](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0016)), the early-Míng continuation of the *Jǐngdé chuándēng lù* 景德傳燈錄 ([KR6q0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0003)). Transmitted separately through the Japanese monastic editions that became the basis of the Xuzangjing.
